# Stack

> Stack is a growing directory of AI stacks for anything people build with AI: curated tools, models and workflows as open JSON. Video and design are the first two live stacks, compute and more are coming, and anyone can propose a new stack.

Browse the Markdown and JSON directly on GitHub or in a local checkout.

## Docs

- [Collection README](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/README.md): Categories, example workflow and contributor credits.
- [Published guides](https://aunysillyme.dev/stack/): The separately maintained guide directory.
- [Video guide](https://aunysillyme.dev/stack/video/): Read the illustrated workflows and model comparison.
- [Design guide](https://aunysillyme.dev/stack/design/): Core design tools, step-by-step workflows and searchable free/freemium inventory.
- [Design stack](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/01-design-stack/README.md): Core design tools, step-by-step workflows and 13-category resource inventory.
- [Design inventory (plain text)](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/01-design-stack/inventory.md): Full 291-entry table plus `free/`, `freemium/`, and `premium/` subfolders.
- [Video stack (plain text)](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/02-video-stack/inventory.md): Video I2V model inventory plus `free/`, `freemium/`, and `premium/` subfolders.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Workflow format, author credit and certification process.

## Reference

- [Category catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/catalog.json): Numbered top-level stack folders (`01-design-stack`, `02-video-stack`).
- [Design metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/01-design-stack/stack.json): Paths for curated design tools, workflows, resource inventory and community entries.
- [Video metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/02-video-stack/stack.json): Paths for curated video workflows, model inventory and community entries.
- [Workflow template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/templates/workflow.json): Fields for a new community submission.
- [License coverage](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/LICENSE.md): Terms for editorial data, original descriptions, scripts and GitHub Actions configuration.
- [Contributor certification](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTOR-CERTIFICATION.md): How to confirm the right to submit a pull request under the repository licenses.

## Common questions

- [Best AI tools for video generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/02-video-stack/inventory.json): Dated model and platform entries with access routes, costs and status. Workflows are in 02-video-stack/canonical.json.
- [AI tools for animation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/02-video-stack/canonical.json): Animation is part of the video stack.
- [AI tools designers use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/main/01-design-stack/canonical.json): 26 core tools and 4 workflows, plus the 291-entry 01-design-stack/inventory.json and free/freemium/premium subfolders.
- [AI tools for UI design](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/01-design-stack/README.md): The web interface workflow and the UI categories in the design inventory.
- [How to submit a workflow](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Start from templates/workflow.json.
- [Add a new kind of stack](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#propose-a-new-stack): Open a [New stack issue](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/issues/new?template=new-stack.yml) with the proposed tools and workflow.

## Optional

- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Editing and offline validation.
- [Maintainer review](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINING.md): Review, consent and credit checks.
